item.title: LOT-147: FEAT-016 additions in M4 (tab rail, pinned or on-demand sidebar)
item.body:
LOT-147
Refs #655 (operator decision of 2026-11-09 on the LOT-147 scope; #655 stays open for its other follow-ups)
Refs #237 #160 (scope only: the lot itself is still to do)
Claim: mac/m2-lead

### Problem
On 2026-11-09 the operator decided that LOT-147 also takes the FEAT-016 items that legacy does not have at `2fe43da3`, and that they go to M4:
- a tab rail when the Duo is folded;
- a sidebar pinned or on demand.

The docs still filed them as M5 with no lot ("Not in this lot" in the spec, FEATURES.md, ROADMAP.md, LOTS.md).

### Change
- **`docs/lots/LOT-147-duo-ipad-columns.md`**
  - New section "Scope (M4): the FEAT-016 additions legacy lacks". It covers:
    - what legacy has instead at `2fe43da3`;
    - what is left to specify;
    - the rule: the lot author writes the design in the spec, and the operator approves it on #237 before any code;
    - defaults keep the legacy layout.
  - The lot's PR says `Closes #160`.
  - "Not in this lot" keeps only:
    - iOS 27.1 APIs as a goal of their own;
    - the iPad layout of LOT-170 / #685;
    - the cover-screen fill (#432);
    - scroll position across a fold.
- **`docs/LOTS.md`**
  - The LOT-147 row: scope and Audit cell.
  - The Liquid Glass paragraph.
  - The "Back to M4" paragraph, which now names these items as the operator's exception to the M5 rule: they are evolutions, not parity.
- **`docs/FEATURES.md`**: FEAT-016 goes to LOT-147, M4, phase 4, status `spec`.
- **`docs/ROADMAP.md`**: M5 no longer lists "the FEAT-016 layouts legacy does not have".
- **`tooling/roadmap/lots.json`**: regenerated.

Both additions are opt-in settings, off by default (FEATURES.md UX principles); a default change needs community support on #160. These items are told apart from the parity part of the same lot by a new GAP row: GAP-655, `new`, `b·operator`. GAP-215 now only describes the legacy inner screen.

`scripts/tests/test_roadmap.py` and `test_docs_*.py` pass, and so does pre-commit on the changed files.

### Ledger

```gap-new
Section: Large and foldable screens
| GAP-655 | iPhone Duo: FEAT-016 additions | None at `2fe43da3`: the folded Duo keeps the tab bar; the topic-list split root opens with the sidebar hidden (`doubleColumn`) and persists the user's show / hide choice until a destination is picked (back to `doubleColumn`); the other destinations' split shows it (`.all`), not persisted; no pin setting. | `MainWindow.swift:1317-1322, 1343, 1355, 1357-1365, 1452-1469, 1796-1820, 2075-2082` @ `2fe43da3` | Opt-in settings, off by default: tab rail when folded; sidebar pinned. Design in the LOT-147 spec, approved by the operator on #237 before code. | LOT-147, FEAT-016 | new | new UX: Bybifok (FEAT-016), M4 by operator decision 2026-11-09 | b·operator |
```

```gap-edit
GAP-215
SwiftHFR final: As legacy at `2fe43da3`: split root unfolded, topic full width in portrait once chosen, list and topic in landscape, fold handoff (GAP-217). LOT-147, M4 (operator 2026-11-09, #655, #659). The FEAT-016 additions are GAP-655.
Gap: same
```

```ledger-note
Supersedes two notes of #690 (still unapplied): apply these instead of #690's note-10 replacement and of its "Not in these rows" replacement; #690's other notes stand.
1. Convergence note 10 "Duo and wide layouts" (line ~288): replace "The rail, the column widths and the portrait behaviour on the Duo inner screen wait for the Phase 5 design document; LOT-147 cannot start before it (GAP-212, 214, 215, 216)." by "The Duo inner screen follows legacy at `2fe43da3` (GAP-215, 217); the rail and the pinned sidebar are FEAT-016 additions in M4, opt-in and off by default (operator 2026-11-09, #237), designed in the LOT-147 spec and approved by the operator before code (GAP-655). GAP-212, 214 and 216 are unchanged."
2. "Liquid Glass and the iOS 27 HIG", **Not in these rows** (line ~249): replace "the Duo and iPad layouts with the iOS 27.1 APIs, LOT-147; " by "" (LOT-147 and its FEAT-016 additions are M4: #655, #237, GAP-215, GAP-655).
3. "Convergence classification (H.1)", table "App lots (80) and features": with #690's move of LOT-147 to "(a) port", add "(and its FEAT-016 additions, GAP-655, `b·operator`)" after 147.
```

Adversarial review (Fable 5.1) of 8ffb14f020e037bdfe73e6a2ec8696f826d0a556: REQUEST CHANGES

Checked: the diff, the `### Ledger` section (`ledger.py check-body --pr 698 --file body.md`: 3 blocks ok; `fold.py --check` ok; `lots_from_md.py` reproduces `lots.json` byte for byte; the 97 roadmap/docs tests pass), the legacy lines at `2fe43da3`, `bybifok-proposals.md:33, 77`, the operator decision recorded on #237 (2026-11-09T18:01Z), the claim on #655 (`/claim mac/m2-lead`), the GAP report on `dev-swift`, and the pending `ledger-note` entries of merged ledger PRs. No other open PR touches these files. The ledger-note quote of convergence note 10 matches the report text exactly (line 288). GAP-215 keeps `a·master` with `same`, GAP-655 (`new` / `b·operator`, section "Large and foldable screens") is a valid row and no fragment, row or other PR body uses that ID.

Findings:

1. **Medium — PR body, `ledger-note` block.** PR #690 (merged, `ledger: done`) has five `ledger-note` entries that the steward has not applied yet (the report still carries the old texts). Two of them target the same sentences as this PR and say the opposite:
   - note 10 (line ~288): #690 replaces "LOT-147 cannot start before it (…)" by "… the rail and the column widths beyond legacy stay with FEAT-016 (…)";
   - "Not in these rows" (line ~249): #690 replaces "the Duo and iPad layouts with the iOS 27.1 APIs, LOT-147" by "the FEAT-016 Duo and iPad layouts legacy does not have (rail, pinned sidebar; LOT-147 ports the legacy Duo layout in M4, #655)", i.e. still an M5 item.
   Failing scenario: the steward applies the pending notes in `docs/ledger-notes-<date>` in merge order; #690's text lands, then this PR's note does not match (its quote is the current report text, not #690's result) or, applied first, is undone by #690's. Line 249 is not covered at all and will say the rail and the pinned sidebar are M5 after this PR.
   Fix: in this PR's `ledger-note`, state that it supersedes #690's note-10 entry (quote both the current text and #690's replacement as acceptable `old` texts, or tell the steward to skip #690's), and add a `ledger-note` for line ~249 that supersedes #690's: e.g. "the composer bar, LOT-174; `Tab(role: .search)`; `tabViewBottomAccessory`" with LOT-147 removed (its FEAT-016 additions are M4, GAP-655, and are not Liquid Glass rows).

2. **Medium — `docs/lots/LOT-147-duo-ipad-columns.md:43` and the `gap-new` row (Legacy behaviour and Legacy ref cells).** "the split root shows the system sidebar, no pin setting" is not what `2fe43da3` does. `MainWindow.swift:1317-1322` defines `SidebarVisibilityStorage` (`HFRswiftIPadSplitColumnVisibilityV3`: `automatic`, `all`, `doubleColumn`, `detailOnly`), `:1355` stores it in `@AppStorage` with default `doubleColumn` (list + detail, **sidebar hidden**), `:1452-1469` binds it to `NavigationSplitView.columnVisibility` so the visibility the user picks with the system button is **persisted across launches**, and `:1702-1709` drives it on the Duo rotation. So legacy's baseline is: sidebar hidden by default, shown on demand with the system button, the choice remembered; there is no setting but there is a persisted state. The spec makes "the legacy behaviour" the default of the future control, so this baseline must be right, and `1357-1365` (the `usesSidebarRoot` rule) does not cover it.
   Fix: rewrite the cell and the spec row ("sidebar hidden by default (`doubleColumn`), toggled with the system button, visibility persisted in `HFRswiftIPadSplitColumnVisibilityV3`; no setting") and add `MainWindow.swift:1317-1322, 1355, 1452-1469` to the Legacy ref cell of GAP-655.

3. **Medium — `docs/lots/LOT-147-duo-ipad-columns.md:38`.** "the 2026-10-28 rule of not taking Bybifok's UX proposals by default" cites a rule that exists nowhere in the repository (`git grep` of the branch finds no such sentence; the 2026-10-28 decisions in the repo are the four UX principles of `docs/FEATURES.md:14-17`). A reader cannot trace it, and the repo frames those decisions as principles, not as a rule about one contributor; naming the contributor this way in a public spec is a wording the operator did not record.
   Fix: cite the FEATURES.md principles instead: "an explicit operator exception to the M5 rule of `docs/LOTS.md` and to the UX principles of `docs/FEATURES.md` (*Preserve what works*, *Defaults keep the legacy UX; changes are opt-in settings*, operator 2026-10-28)".

4. **Medium — `docs/lots/LOT-147-duo-ipad-columns.md:42` ("To specify before coding").** A tab rail replacing the bottom bar on the folded Duo touches the *Preserve what works* principle (`docs/FEATURES.md:12, 14`: "the legacy bottom bar Catégories / Favoris / Messages / Plus … stay as they are"), and FEATURES.md:12 says a proposal that breaks a principle "needs the operator's approval and, for navigation, the community's support recorded on its issue". The spec has the operator's approval but says nothing about the second condition, and does not say whether the rail is opt-in (principle kept) or a default (community support needed on #160).
   Fix: add to the "To specify" cell of the rail row: "opt-in (principle *Preserve what works* kept) or default (then the community's support is recorded on #160, FEATURES.md:12)".

5. **Low — `docs/ROADMAP.md:55` (Phase 5).** "Column-based navigation and large/foldable layouts beyond what legacy has (the legacy iPhone Duo layout at `2fe43da3` is LOT-147, M4, #655). Design documentation provided by the maintainer." still files the layouts beyond legacy in Phase 5 with a maintainer design document, while FEATURES.md now says Phase 4 and "design in the LOT-147 spec". Fix: say the Duo rail and sidebar additions are LOT-147 too (M4, #237, designed in the spec), and leave only what is really left for Phase 5.

6. **Low — `docs/lots/LOT-186-reader-chrome.md:47`.** "No iOS 27.1 API (those would serve FEAT-016's own layouts, M5; LOT-147 ports the legacy Duo layout in M4, #655)" now contradicts this PR (the FEAT-016 layouts are M4). Fix: "(those would serve the FEAT-016 additions of LOT-147, M4, #237)".

7. **Low — `docs/LOTS.md:283` (M5 intro).** "the features that wait on a design document" + "The iPhone Duo layout (LOT-147) moved …: legacy has it at `2fe43da3`" is true but incomplete: say that its FEAT-016 additions moved with it (operator 2026-11-09, #237) so the M5 section does not read as if they stayed.

Nits (no push for them alone):
- `docs/ROADMAP.md:16`, M4 row: "the evolutions are in M5" now has one recorded exception; "(exception: GAP-655, LOTS.md)" would keep the row honest.
- The H.1 "App lots (80) and features" table, hand-written, will file LOT-147 under "(a) port" once #690's pending note is applied; it now has a (b·operator) half. Worth a line in the ledger-note when fixing finding 1.
- Pre-existing, not this PR: `docs/ux/audit-m5-ux-ui.md:134` and `docs/assets/gap/gap.html:398` keep the M5 / "design document missing" wording; both are dated snapshots, fine to leave.
